Dustin Williams There's more than one way you can get health insurance through Clalit - (1) You can buy it through a broker such as Harel, or (2) You can purchase it directly from them, and with a big discount if your partner is with them. If your partner is with them, then definitely go for number (2) and don't contact Harel. 

You need to follow the instructions on our website, in the link posted above. There can be problems sometimes as some Clalit clerks don't know about this option - if you have this problem, contact AIC support with the details and we can help get things working behind the scenes.
